title: 1495. Custom Array-Based Queue in Java

Custom Array-Based Queue in Java
30

Problem Statement:
Write a Java program that defines a custom QueueInterface with methods enqueue, dequeue, and peek. Implement this interface using an array. You should define your own interface and a class that implements queue operations without using java.util.Queue. 
Input Description:
A series of commands: enqueue x, dequeue, peek, exit. 
Output Description:
Result of each dequeue or peek operation. 
Sample Input:
enqueue 1
enqueue 2
peek
dequeue
peek
exit 
Sample Output:
1
1
2
